interface.shortDescription: Project process and knowledge over grounded research
interface.longDescription: Project-process overlay for agile-workflow with prior-art scouting, intent-based research entrypoints, architecture and design integration, a three-layer knowledge index and graph, cross-host context hooks, document review, and release quality orchestration. Requires agentic-research for grounded research execution and ARD verification.
defaultPrompt: Use research-pipeline to load the knowledge index and recommend the next research or design step.

content.name: agentic-research
content.description: Agentic Research Discipline (ARD) — grounded, verifiable AI research: a non-erodable anti-fabrication floor, selectable verification gates, and a .research/ substrate tier of attestations and syntheses that parallels .work/. ARD is the plugin's internal, empirically-warranted discipline (ard-core/).

content.name: agentic-research
content.description: Agentic Research Discipline (ARD) — grounded, verifiable AI research with a non-erodable anti-fabrication floor, selectable verification gates, and a .research/ substrate tier paralleling .work/. ARD is the plugin's internal, empirically-warranted discipline (ard-core/).

interface.longDescription: ARD makes AI research grounded and verifiable: a non-erodable anti-fabrication floor, a per-engagement control-space of selectable verification gates, and a .research/ substrate tier (attestations, precis, analytical syntheses) paralleling the operational .work/ tier. Citations use the [handle]{N} convention with per-source attestations, enforced by a citation-chain lint. ARD is the plugin's internal, empirically-warranted discipline, maintained in ard-core/.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-research to run a grounded research engagement with citation attestations and verification gates.

diff --git a/plugins/agentic-research/scripts/tests/skill-metadata.test.sh b/plugins/agentic-research/scripts/tests/skill-metadata.test.sh
new file mode 100755
index 00000000..0d14d677
--- /dev/null
+++ b/plugins/agentic-research/scripts/tests/skill-metadata.test.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+
+script_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
+plugin_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/../.." && pwd)
+
+python3 - "$plugin_root" <<'PY'
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import yaml
+
+root = Path(sys.argv[1])
+metadata = root / "skills" / "research-orchestrator" / "agents" / "openai.yaml"
+document = yaml.safe_load(metadata.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+prompt = document.get("interface", {}).get("default_prompt")
+if not isinstance(prompt, str) or "$research-orchestrator" not in prompt:
+    raise AssertionError(f"{metadata}: default prompt does not name the skill")
+
+policy = document.get("policy", {}).get("allow_implicit_invocation")
+if policy is not True:
+    raise AssertionError(
+        f"{metadata}: research-orchestrator must allow implicit invocation for "
+        "research-pipeline cross-plugin routing"
+    )
+PY
+
+printf '%s\n' 'agentic-research skill metadata: ok'

+++ b/plugins/agentic-research/skills/research-orchestrator/agents/openai.yaml
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@ interface:

 policy:
-  allow_implicit_invocation: false
+  allow_implicit_invocation: true
